business.name: Best Western Plus French Quarter Courtyard Hotel

ranking.name: Best Western Plus French Quarter Courtyard Hotel

text.text_excerpt: This hotel has friendly and accommodating staff. The hotel it's self is small and kept clean. About 4 blocks from bourbon and all the action. It's far enough to be quite at night though. It's really a great location. Beds are comfortable, everything worked in the room, the water pressure was low for our liking however. The only bad thing about this place is the parking. It's $30 a day and very cramped. There's cement poles making some of the spots hard to get in and out of. The best things is the great hot breakfast and the friendly bartender! Enjoy NOLA

I loved my stay at this hotel, and it surpassed all my expectations. The check in was quick and easy, and the staff was friendly. The courtyard pool area is so quaint and inviting, I enjoyed lounging by the pool and just taking it easy. The rooms are small, but clean and updated. The room was always cleaned while my husband and I ate breakfast(The free breakfast is really good and worth waking up early for.)which was very convinient.On the days when we would sleep in, we would always come back to a clean room. This hotel is just a hop, skip and a jump away from all the action of the French Quarter. It is also right across from Louis Armstrong park, which my husband and I took advantage of...

Excellent hotel. It's not a literally 5 star hotel but the experience and service they provide is 5 star if not more. The staff is exceptional here. You name it and the will service your needs. The room is nice. It was over looking the Courtyard which can be good and bad depending on your desire at the time. You will here conversations going on when people are sitting out there drinking and laughing. Im sure the fun in the pool as well in summer months. But it's not ignoring if the crowd is respectful to the noise level. Room is very clean and has refrigerator but no microwave. Shower is strong and refreshing. Big enough for two if in that moment.
